summary: The freeze order holds. PROTOCOL.md and the runner were frozen at 0afe01c59d; the only later change is the one-statement hash-line fix 4424e037d8, made before any cell; all 8 cell files were added once, afterwards. The archived binary matches the frozen hash and every cell's record. A replay of k20 m3 d = 12 and d = 14 reproduces both cells exactly, apart from timing. Errata E2-E11 cover rounding, restart timing, load and host disclosure, unverifiable wording about when the cells aborted, the parity narrative, a post-data edit of the analysis script, the rho/closure wording, the balanced-total qualifier and the figure. None changes a measured number or a preregistered verdict.
